reason: ClaudeAgentSdkConnection in harnesses.py treated each Claude CLI turn as a request/response pair it could abandon, but the CLI is one long-lived ordered stream. After an operator Stop, a stream_turn failure or a turn the CLI started itself for a finished background task, the next receive_response() stopped at the stale ResultMessage, so the next prompt got the previous turn's leftovers (HARN-1); interrupt() only acted while the turn generator was alive, so the interrupt stream_turn sends after the generator's finally never reached the CLI (HARN-3); the connection had no connection_state, SDK process errors were not transport errors and a stream that ended without a result counted as a completed turn, so a dead CLI stayed cached and failed every later turn (HARN-2). The connection now owns the stream through one reader task that files every message in order, tracks the open vendor turn separately from the generator (set after query(), cleared when its ResultMessage is read), and on interrupt() or at the next run_turn interrupts and drains that turn's tail bounded by HARNESS_INTERRUPT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (a failed or timed-out settle marks the connection disconnected); before query() it files turns the CLI ran on its own as out-of-band notices. connection_state reads the reader and the SDK transport/process via getattr, SDK errors become HarnessTransportError, and a stream end without a result fails the turn. stream_turn now also discards a connection whose failure-path interrupt raised. The durable answer is ResultMessage.result or the text after the last top-level tool use; pre-tool narration moves to commentary and subagent text is ignored (HARN-10). Error results use the SDK's precedence (errors, result, non-success subtype, API error (HTTP n)) with subtype/terminal_reason/api_error_status in the notice payload, and raise HarnessTurnFailedError so budget and max-turn failures keep the connection (HARN-12). Streamed blocks are keyed per message_start and parent, and a streamed thinking block is not reported again from the AssistantMessage (HARN-17). tests/v3/test_claude_harness_turns.py (21 tests, all failing on origin/main) drives the real claude_agent_sdk ClaudeSDKClient 0.2.118 over a scripted CLI transport and the real HarnessRuntimeService; two existing Claude fakes gained receive_messages() and one expected event list gained the commentary delta; the listed existing node ids exercise the changed Claude connection and stream_turn failure/interrupt paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through harnesses.py) does not drive a Claude CLI turn, which needs a scripted CLI; the Python tests drive ClaudeAgentSdkConnection and HarnessRuntimeService directly. test_harness_adapters.py, test_harnesses.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_approval_handoff.py, test_diagnostic_guidance.py, test_codex_turn_outcomes.py, test_minimal_agent_instructions.py and the harness tests of test_api.py, test_browser_companion.py and test_diagnostics_api.py were run locally and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
